evidence.title: Colormind - the AI powered color palette generator
Colormind API - extracting colors from photos and video

name: Colormind
summary: AI color palette generator that builds color schemes with a deep neural net, plus a free REST API.
description: Generates five-color palettes in one click with a deep-learning model that has learned color styles from photographs, film and games; datasets such as Pokemon Crystal palettes, Makoto Shinkai films, portrait photography and technicolor cinema rotate daily. Lock any color to steer generation, apply palettes to Bootstrap dashboard templates, or call the REST API, which is free for personal and non-commercial use.
contains: daily rotating learned datasets: Pokemon Crystal, Makoto Shinkai, portrait photography, film stills
image upload to extract colors from photos and video
palette previews on Bootstrap templates (Paper Dashboard, Material Dashboard)
REST API free for personal and non-commercial use
